case.summary: Tenant received a 3-day notice to pay rent or quit and then an eviction filing. Tenant had withheld one month's rent after repeatedly reporting a broken heater and a persistent leak the landlord never repaired. Tenant has continued to pay all other months on time.
case.reliefSought: To defend against the eviction by raising the landlord's failure to maintain habitable conditions, and to remain housed.

timeline.event: Tenant first reported a broken heater and bathroom leak in writing.
Tenant sent a second written repair request; no repairs made.
Tenant withheld February rent and notified the landlord why, in writing.
Landlord served a 3-day notice to pay or quit.
Landlord filed an unlawful detainer (eviction) action.

evidence.description: Two dated written repair requests for the heater and leak.
Photos and a short video of the non-working heater and active leak.
Bank records showing on-time rent for every month except the one withheld.
The 3-day notice and the filed unlawful detainer complaint.
